This is SWU Scanner, a Star Wars: Unlimited card scanner that runs entirely in your browser. Take a photo of your cards and get a priced list in euros.
I pick a photo with nine cards. The app reads it right on the device, and shows a progress bar and how many cards it has found so far.
Here are the nine cards it found. Each one shows its language, mostly French here, with the English title underneath.
If the language is wrong, open the card and change it. The title follows the language you pick.
Then choose the printing, and the Cardmarket price appears, in euros.
Add everything to the list, and the total updates. Cards that still need a version are counted separately.
Finally, share the list as a link. The prices travel with it, so whoever opens the link sees exactly the same totals.
That's SWU Scanner. It's free, installable, and works offline.
